desc: Establish the greedy/exchange argument and choose the two-pointer approach.

Implement a Python program that reads N and the list A from stdin, uses two pointers i = 0 and j = N // 2, counts pairs while i < N // 2 and j < N using the integer condition 2 * A[i] <= A[j], and prints the final count.
Verify the implementation on the sample inputs and edge cases such as N = 2, all equal sizes, odd/even N, and maximum values.
